question.disease_name: Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features

sampled_features.disease_name: Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features

additional_requirements: delusions_and_hallucinations occur exclusively during the manic episode

S020.name: Hallucinations
S020.description: Perception-like experiences that occur without an external stimulus and are as vivid and clear as normal perception.

subtypes.Auditory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of hearing voices or sounds when there is no actual sound.
subtypes.Visual Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of seeing people or objects that do not exist.
subtypes.Tactile Hallucinations: Experiencing the sensation of being touched or movement on the skin when there is no actual stimulus.
subtypes.Olfactory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of smelling odors that do not exist.
subtypes.Gustatory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of tasting flavors that are not actually present.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S025.name: Loss_of_Interest
S025.description: A state where interest or pleasure in previously enjoyed activities is markedly diminished.

subtypes.Loss of Interest: Reduced interest in previously enjoyed hobbies or leisure activities.
subtypes.Social Withdrawal: Reduced interest or effort in social interactions and maintaining relationships.
subtypes.Loss of Motivation: Lack of motivation to initiate or complete work or tasks.
subtypes.Anhedonia: Inability to experience positive emotions such as happiness, satisfaction, love, or pleasure.
subtypes.Indifference to Achievement: Insensitivity or indifference to personal achievements or success.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.

subtypes.Significant Weight Loss: Weight loss of more than 5% in a month without dieting.
subtypes.Weight Gain: Weight gain of more than 5% in a month.
subtypes.Decrease in Appetite: Decrease in appetite occurring nearly every day.
subtypes.Increase in Appetite: Increase in appetite occurring nearly every day.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S032.name: Death_Suicide
S032.description: Recurrent thoughts of death, recurrent suicidal ideation, or a suicide attempt.

subtypes.Recurrent Thoughts of Death: Passive wish to die (e.g., 'I wish I wouldn't wake up') without active intent to kill oneself.
subtypes.Suicidal Ideation: Recurring thoughts of 'I want to die' or 'I want to kill myself' without a specific plan.
subtypes.Suicidal Impulse: Strong, sudden urges to jump from a height or run into traffic without a concrete plan.
subtypes.Specific Plan for Suicide: Conceiving specific scenarios or methods regarding when, where, and how to die.
subtypes.Suicide Attempt: Actual actions taken to end one's life or preparatory behaviors like hoarding pills or writing a will.

S033.name: Elevated_Irritable_Mood
S033.description: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.

subtypes.Elevated Mood: A mood that is abnormally high, euphoric, and full of unmotivated happiness and vitality.
subtypes.Irritable Mood: A state where one gets angry or aggressive even at minor stimuli.
subtypes.Mood Lability: Rapid shifts in mood, alternating unpredictably between euphoria and irritability.

S034.name: Increased_Activity
S034.description: Abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.

subtypes.Increased Energy: Overflowing physical and mental energy, leading to an inability to stay still and a desire to keep moving.
subtypes.Hyperactivity: Doing far more work than usual or starting multiple activities simultaneously.
subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Inability to tolerate resting or stopping, driven by a constant need to do something.

S035.name: Inflated_Self_Esteem
S035.description: Inflated self-esteem or grandiosity (may range from uncritical self-confidence to delusional proportions).

subtypes.Inflated Self-Confidence: Feeling capable of anything and believing that failure is impossible, unlike one's usual self.
subtypes.Overestimation of Abilities: Unrealistically assessing one's talents, knowledge, or abilities as superior.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one is a special and important person with a special mission or purpose.

S036.name: Decreased_Sleep
S036.description: Decreased need for sleep (e.g., feels rested after only 3 hours of sleep).

subtypes.Reduced Sleep Duration: Sleeping significantly less than usual but feeling refreshed rather than tired.
subtypes.Loss of Sleep Need: Not feeling the urge to sleep or the thought that sleep is necessary.
subtypes.Indifference to Insomnia: Feeling no problem and continuing activities despite staying up for several nights.

S037.name: Pressured_Speech
S037.description: More talkative than usual or pressure to keep talking.

subtypes.Talkativeness: Speaking far more than usual and continuing to talk without rest.
subtypes.Rapid Speech: Speech speed is so fast that it is difficult for others to understand or interrupt.
subtypes.Pressured Speech: Cannot stop talking or tolerate silence due to an internal pressure to keep speaking.

S038.name: Racing_Thoughts
S038.description: Flight of ideas or subjective experience that thoughts are racing.

subtypes.Racing Thoughts: Thoughts spinning too fast in the head, constantly jumping from one idea to another.
subtypes.Flooding of Thoughts: Too many thoughts emerging simultaneously, making them disorganized.
subtypes.Inability to Control Thoughts: Unable to stop or slow down thoughts and unable to calm the mind.

info.persona: Chung Tran is a fiercely organized, solitary competitor who turns every aspect of life into a data‑driven challenge, from project pipelines to personal fitness, despite a stubborn tendency to delay routine check‑ups.
info.professional_persona: Chung Tran, a data‑driven senior program manager, utilizes Agile, Lean Six Sigma, Python, and Power BI to streamline high‑budget technology deployments, and they channel their competitive, solitary nature into relentless process optimization and a rapid climb toward PMO leadership.
info.cultural_background: Deven was raised in a Vietnamese‑American household in the Chicago suburbs, making him bilingual in English and Vietnamese. His family maintained traditional celebrations such as Tet and regularly prepared dishes like phở and bánh mì, while also embracing Midwestern American values of independence and practicality. His parents, both professionals in engineering fields, emphasized academic excellence, disciplined work ethic, and respect for hierarchy—principles that resonate with his organized, achievement‑driven personality. Although he appreciates his Southeast Asian heritage, Deven prefers quiet, solitary pursuits and often participates in cultural events only in small family settings, balancing his cultural roots with his introverted disposition.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Deven gravitates toward solitary, structured activities that satisfy his competitive streak and demand discipline. He enjoys playing chess online and at local clubs, solving puzzles such as Sudoku and crosswords, and programming small automation scripts in Python. Outdoor pursuits include solo hikes on nearby forest trails and landscape photography, which provide quiet reflection. He also dedicates time to woodworking projects, weightlifting routines, and a daily meditation practice that enhances focus and resilience. Reading non‑fiction on productivity, technology trends, and self‑improvement rounds out his intellectual interests.
info.sports_persona: Chung Tran, a solitary fitness enthusiast, follows the Seattle Seahawks and Seattle Kraken, they train at Anytime Fitness Seattle’s strength club, log weekly weightlifting sessions, and embark on solo hikes with the Washington Hiking Association on Mount Si, while occasionally snowboarding in the Cascades during winter.
info.arts_persona: Chung Tran, an avid landscape photographer, draws inspiration from Ansel Adams and Japanese ukiyo‑e prints, they collect a vintage Leica M6, appreciate the minimalist lines of Shaker furniture, unwind listening to Ludovico Einaudi and Radiohead, and regularly attend photography exhibitions at the Seattle Art Museum.
info.travel_persona: Chung Tran, a meticulous solo traveler, has mapped detailed itineraries for trips to Iceland’s volcanic fields, Japan’s tech districts, and New Zealand’s Milford Track, they use spreadsheet budgeting and travel‑planning software to optimize costs, and they aspire to trek Patagonia’s Torres del Paine next year.
info.culinary_persona: Chung Tran, a pragmatic home cook, favors high‑protein meals like grilled salmon with quinoa, perfects Japanese miso ramen with precise broth ratios, experiments with sous‑vide chicken breast, they track macros in MyFitnessPal, and they indulge in a weekly pour‑over coffee from a specialty café.

info.persona: Allison Hatfield balances quiet curiosity with practical organization, turning solitary hobbies like knitting and genealogy into community‑focused endeavors while they quietly mentor coworkers and plan a modest craft‑business retirement.
info.professional_persona: Allison Hatfield, a seasoned warehouse inventory specialist, blends meticulous organization with a practical curiosity about emerging RFID technology, they use barcode expertise and warehouse management software to streamline order fulfillment while quietly mentoring new hires and balancing procedural consistency with flexible problem‑solving.
info.cultural_background: Allison grew up in rural East Tennessee, where community ties, modesty, and self‑reliance are deeply valued. Her upbringing was shaped by Southern hospitality, a strong work ethic, and regular participation in local church events, reflecting a Protestant tradition of fellowship and service. While she respects longstanding customs—such as storytelling, seasonal festivals, and regional cuisine—she also embraces new ideas, evident in her curiosity about technology and diverse reading interests. This blend of practical conservatism and quiet openness informs her balanced outlook on life.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In her free time, Allison enjoys solitary yet rewarding pursuits. She often curls up with historical fiction, knits scarves and blankets, and tends a vegetable garden where she grows tomatoes, beans, and herbs. Hiking the nearby foothills, birdwatching, and baking seasonal pies bring her a sense of calm. She also researches her family genealogy, participates in a small local book club, and volunteers at the community food pantry, blending her curiosity with a desire to help others.
info.sports_persona: Allison Hatfield enjoys low‑impact fitness through weekend hikes in the foothills and seasonal birdwatching walks, occasionally joining a local 5‑k charity run, and they cheer on the Colorado Rockies in spring while keeping a modest membership at the community trail club.
info.arts_persona: Allison Hatfield immerses themselves in historical fiction by Hilary Mantel and Philippa Gregory, knits intricate blankets while listening to Joni Mitchell, participates in a small book club discussing classics, and they attend the town’s community theater for productions like A Raisin in the Sun, drawing inspiration from Georgia O'Keeffe’s floral paintings.
info.travel_persona: Allison Hatfield prefers thoughtfully planned, budget‑conscious travel, spending most weekends on day trips to nearby state parks such as Red Rock Canyon, while dreaming of a genealogy‑focused visit to York, England and a relaxed summer getaway to Savannah, Georgia, where they can wander historic squares at a leisurely pace.
info.culinary_persona: Allison Hatfield enjoys moderate‑level cooking, regularly baking seasonal apple‑cinnamon pies and peach crumb tarts, crafting homemade tomato‑basil soup and rosemary‑infused grape vinaigrette from garden herbs, and they take pride in preserving heirloom tomatoes in sweet‑savory jam.

info.persona: Dennis Mcdaniel, a 54-year-old retail veteran who oscillates between meticulous product knowledge and a laid-back, sometimes disorganized lifestyle, channels their competitive edge into fishing, chess, and tailgating while wrestling with chronic worry and a habit of postponing health check-ups for another round of vinyl hunting.
info.professional_persona: Dennis Mcdaniel, a seasoned retail salesperson with a knack for translating product specs into compelling pitches, leverages their practical curiosity and relaxed, improvisational style to excel in customer service, visual merchandising, and conflict resolution while quietly competing to out-sell peers and climb toward a district-manager role.
info.cultural_background: Dennis grew up in a modest, working‑class family in a small town outside Columbia, South Carolina. As a white Southern male, he was shaped by the region's traditions of hospitality, community church involvement, and a strong emphasis on self‑reliance. The local culture of barbecues, gospel music, and high school football games infused his upbringing with a blend of communal celebration and personal independence. Although he never married, the social fabric of his hometown provided steady, informal networks of friends and acquaintances. His high‑school education, combined with the practical, hands‑on experiences of his community, fostered a pragmatic worldview that values tangible results and a flexible approach to life.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his free time Dennis balances social outings with solitary pursuits. He enjoys early‑morning fishing trips at nearby lakes, where he can unwind and focus on the quiet of nature. At home, he spends hours woodworking, crafting furniture pieces that reflect his practical creativity. He frequents a local coffee shop to play chess, satisfying his competitive streak while engaging in light conversation. Dennis also follows college football, especially the Gamecocks, and enjoys attending tailgate gatherings. His interests extend to listening to classic rock, collecting vinyl records, reading true‑crime novels, and occasionally experimenting with home‑brewing, all of which offer a blend of relaxation and intellectual curiosity.
info.sports_persona: Dennis Mcdaniel, a devoted fan of the South Carolina Gamecocks football team and a frequent tailgate participant, combines early-morning fishing trips with the Lakeview Anglers Club, occasional pick-up basketball at the community center, and membership in the local adult softball league, yet they often let a relaxed, disorganized schedule dictate when they actually get to exercise.
info.arts_persona: Dennis Mcdaniel, a vinyl-obsessed collector who spends Saturday afternoons hunched over a turntable spinning Led Zeppelin, The Rolling Stones, and Pink Floyd while also devouring Ann Rule's true-crime novellas and occasionally quoting Clint Eastwood movies during chess games at the coffee shop, channels their practical creativity into woodworking projects that echo the raw, analog aesthetic of their musical tastes.
info.travel_persona: Dennis Mcdaniel, who prefers spontaneous road trips to nearby lakes like Lake Hartwell and seasonal leaf-watching drives through the Blue Ridge Mountains, has also taken a modest vacation to New Orleans for its jazz scene and dreams of a low-key heritage tour of Edinburgh's historic pubs, yet their stress-prone nature often leads to last-minute bookings and a reluctance to commit to expensive, fully planned itineraries.
info.culinary_persona: Dennis Mcdaniel, a moderately skilled home chef who relishes smoking catfish with hickory chips, perfecting a Southern-style shrimp and grits dish, and experimenting with hop-forward IPAs in his home-brewing kits, often balances a love for smoky barbeque with occasional indulgence in upscale steakhouse ribeye meals, while they occasionally over-brew and forget to clean the kettle in their relaxed routine.
